cases.element: hints[0] (kind "translation", example "la cartera" → "гаманець") with targets ["object-pron.lo-la/written-form"]
cases.defect: A vocabulary gloss/translation hint is attributed to the grammar target, which rule 6 forbids. It also shows the article "la", which leaks the answer form. Minor: "cartera" is not in taughtBefore and is glossed only in a hint, not in the prompt (rule 1).
cases.correction: Set hints[0].targets to [] (or gloss "cartera" as a word without its article, inside the prompt). Keep the rule hint as the only hint that supports the grammar target.
cases.notes: Key and errors are correct: No la encuentro.

Correct key. Terminology across the packet: Ukrainian "тильда" means the sign ~. Calling the acute accent mark by that name copies the Spanish word "tilde"; "знак наголосу" would be clearer. This is a packet-wide convention, not counted as a defect here.

cases.element: hints[0].blocks[0].text: "Назви днів тижня в іспанській завжди пишуться з великої літери, як в англійській: Lunes, Martes, Jueves."
cases.defect: False rule. In Spanish, the names of the days of the week are common nouns and are written in lowercase (lunes, martes, jueves). The prompt itself correctly writes "el jueves".
cases.correction: "Назви днів тижня в іспанській пишуться з малої літери (на відміну від англійської): lunes, martes, jueves."
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), ch. IV, uso de minúsculas: días de la semana (from memory)
cases.notes: The key and option feedback are correct.

cases.element: clips[0].translationUk and hints[0].blocks[0].text: "Зустрічаємося завтра через пів дня біля входу до музею."
cases.defect: "a mediodía" means "at noon" (опівдні), not "in half a day" (через пів дня). The mistranslation contradicts the correct option a and the feedback. Secondary: taughtBefore lists "quedar (A1-06-L4)", which is a later lesson than A1-05-L3, so the ordering looks wrong.
cases.correction: "Зустрічаємося завтра опівдні біля входу до музею." in both the clip and the hint. Check that quedar is really taught before A1-05-L3, or gloss it.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Sentaos (informal guests, Spain) or Siéntense (formal); both fit
cases.element: prompt[0].text "До вас щойно прийшли гості. Запросіть їх сісти (sentarse)."; accepted only "Siéntense"; errors e1 "Sentaos"
cases.defect: The prompt does not fix the register. In Spain, guests are often friends or family, who are addressed with vosotros ("Sentaos"), which the lesson teaches. The closed key accepts only the ustedes form and marks "Sentaos" as an error.
cases.correction: Either say the guests are formal (e.g., "Ви вітаєте незнайомих клієнтів, звертаючись на ustedes"), or accept "Sentaos" as well.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática §16.15–16.16 (usted/vosotros in Spain) (from memory)

cases.element: hints[0].blocks[0].text: "…дієприкметник на -ido завжди пишеться з тильдою над í: leído, oído, traído, construído, incluído."
cases.defect: False rule and wrong spellings. The participles of -uir verbs are written without an accent: construido, incluido (the ui sequence counts as a diphthong for written-accent purposes). The written accent applies only after a, e, o (leído, oído, traído), so "завжди" overclaims.
cases.correction: "Якщо основа закінчується на a, e або o, дієприкметник пишемо з наголосом над í: leído, oído, traído. (Але construido, incluido — без наголосу.)"
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), ch. I §4.2 — ui as diphthong (from memory)

cases.notes: "Ayer tarde" is natural in Spain. Optional: "учора після обіду" is slightly more standard than "по обіді".

cases.element: accepted v2 "Se las" with noteUk "Також правильно: множину «vecinos» можна перенести на займенник."
cases.defect: The direct object is singular (la llave), so "las" is wrong. Moving the plural of the indirect object onto the direct pronoun (se los/se las) is a non-standard, mainly American, colloquial pattern. It is not acceptable in standard Spain Spanish, and the note teaches it as a correct rule.
cases.correction: Remove v2 and add "Se las" to errors with feedback: "«la» замінює «la llave» (однина); «se» не показує множину: «Se la dejo»."
sources: DPD, entry "se" 2 ("se los" for "se lo") (from memory)

cases.reviewerAnswer: ¿Ya habéis comido? / ¿Habéis comido ya? (vosotros); also ¿Ya ha comido (usted)? / ¿Ya han comido? if formal
cases.element: prompt[0].text "Перекладіть іспанською: «Ви вже поїли?»"; closed accepted list contains only habéis forms
cases.defect: Ukrainian "Ви" can mean plural informal (vosotros), polite singular (usted) or polite plural (ustedes). The task does not fix which, and taughtBefore covers all persons. The closed key rejects "¿Ya ha comido?" and "¿Ya han comido?".
cases.correction: Add context, e.g., "(звертаючись до двох друзів)", or accept the usted/ustedes forms with word-order variants.

cases.element: errors e1 "Iros" with feedbackUk "«Iros» — помилка: це інфінітив із займенником, а не наказовий спосіб."
cases.defect: The RAE now accepts "iros" as a valid vosotros imperative of irse, alongside "idos", because it is widespread in Spain. The closed key rejects a valid answer, and the feedback gives a false explanation.
cases.correction: Add "Iros" to accepted with a noteUk such as: "RAE також приймає «iros»; у підручниках частіше «idos»." Remove e1.
sources: RAE, statement on "iros" as valid imperative (c. 2017–2018) (from memory)

cases.notes: "a las ocho de la tarde" = 20:00 is standard in Spain.

cases.reviewerAnswer: trabajaba or trabajó (both grammatical without a time frame)
cases.element: prompt[1].text "Mi abuelo ___ en una fábrica de muebles de Valencia."; option b "trabajó" marked incorrect
cases.defect: Nothing in the sentence marks it as habitual or background. "Mi abuelo trabajó en una fábrica…" is correct for a completed stage of life. The key accepts only one reading, and the feedback asserts habituality that the text does not show.
cases.correction: Add a context marker, e.g., "Cuando yo era pequeño, mi abuelo ___…" (imperfecto), or accept both options.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática §23.11–23.12 (canté vs cantaba) (from memory)

cases.notes: "coger el autobús" is correct Spain usage.

cases.element: prompt[1].text "Vosotros ___ muy bien español." vs taughtBefore "…yo, tú, él/ella/usted (hablo, hablas, habla)"
cases.defect: The task tests the vosotros form, but taughtBefore covers only yo/tú/él/ella/usted, and the vosotros pronoun is not listed either. This is an untaught prerequisite.
cases.correction: Use a taught person, e.g., "Tú ___ muy bien español." → "hablas", or move the task to after vosotros is taught.
cases.notes: The form "habláis" itself is correct. Terminology note on "тильда" as in cal-02.

cases.element: accepted v1 "vió"; errors e1 "vio"; hints[0] text "…habló, comió, vió."; referenceAnswer "vió"
cases.defect: "vio" is a monosyllable for written-accent purposes and is written without an accent. "vió" is a spelling error. The key, error feedback and hint all reverse this, and contradict the target's own name ("monosyllables-no-accent").
cases.correction: Accept "vio". Add "vió" as an error with feedback: "Односкладові форми vio, dio, fue, fui пишуться без наголосу." Fix the hint and the referenceAnswer to match.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), ch. II §3.4.1 (monosílabos ortográficos) (from memory)

cases.element: options[1].feedbackUk "Неправильно. Ця слово жіночого роду…"
cases.defect: Ukrainian agreement error: "слово" is neuter, so the demonstrative must be "це", not "ця".
cases.correction: "Неправильно. Це слово жіночого роду, тому потрібен артикль «la»."
sources: Український правопис (2019) / standard Ukrainian grammar: demonstrative agreement (from memory)

cases.notes: Both agreements are accepted for "la mayoría de + plural noun" (DPD "mayoría", from memory). Plural is more common.

Optional: taughtBefore lists only the -duj- stem. The unstressed ending -o (condujo, not *condujió) should also be taught explicitly. Feedback "c змінюється на j" is a simplification (-duc- → -duj-) but acceptable.

cases.element: accepted v1 "3,02", v2 "3.02"; referenceAnswer "3,02"
cases.defect: "tres euros con veinte" is €3.20, not €3.02. The key accepts a wrong amount and would reject the correct one in auto-grading.
cases.correction: Accept "3,20" and "3.20" (optionally "3,2"), and set referenceAnswer to "3,20". Optionally add "3,02" as an error with feedback explaining that «con veinte» = 20 céntimos.

cases.reviewerAnswer: he llamado if the morning is today; llamé if another day — both possible
cases.element: prompt[1].text "Por la mañana ___ a mi hermana."; errors e1 "llamé"; hint cites "esta mañana"
cases.defect: "Por la mañana" without "esta" or "hoy" does not say whether the period is finished, so "llamé" is equally possible (e.g., a story about yesterday). The hint relies on "esta mañana", which is not in the sentence.
cases.correction: Use "Esta mañana ___ a mi hermana." (or "Hoy por la mañana…"), or accept both forms.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática §23.7–23.8 (he cantado vs canté in Spain) (from memory)

cases.notes: Open key with unresolved fallback is appropriate. Terminology note on "тильда" as in cal-02.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Cannot be determined: Pablo or Professor Ruiz (option a or b)
cases.element: prompt[0].text "Ana, Pablo y el profesor Ruiz están en la biblioteca. Ana le da un diccionario."; option b keyed correct; options[0].feedbackUk "У цьому реченні «le» — це професор Руїс."
cases.defect: Singular "le" has two possible male singular referents (Pablo and Professor Ruiz). Nothing in the text picks one, so the key and the feedback state an unsupported reading.
cases.correction: Make the referent unique, e.g., "El profesor Ruiz necesita un diccionario. Ana le da uno.", or remove Pablo from the scene.

cases.notes: Homophone risk: "Haber" sounds the same, and the course teaches haber. Since the target formula is taught as a whole and a bare infinitive is not a plausible utterance, the key stands. Optional: put the formula in a short carrier sentence, or add "Haber" as a reviewed error with feedback.

cases.element: prompt[1].text "El lunes (yo) ___ (ir) al dentista." under target "indefinido.regular-ar/written-form"; hints[0] (-ar endings)
cases.defect: ir is an irregular verb, not a regular -ar verb. Its indefinido (fui) is not in taughtBefore, the task does not assess the stated target, and the -ar rule hint does not apply to it.
cases.correction: Use a regular -ar verb, e.g., "El lunes (yo) ___ (llamar) al dentista." → "llamé" (error "llame"), and keep the -ar hint.
cases.notes: "fui" without an accent and the "fuí" error are correct in themselves.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Cannot be determined: 8:00 or 20:00 (option a or b)
cases.element: clips[0].transcript "Te espero en la estación a las ocho."; option b keyed correct; options[0].feedbackUk "Ні, зустріч о 20:00."
cases.defect: Bare "a las ocho" with no de la mañana/tarde/noche and no context can mean 8:00 or 20:00. The key and the option a feedback assert 20:00 without support.
cases.correction: Add "de la tarde" to the clip (as in cal-11), or offer only one "eight" option (e.g., "О восьмій" vs "О шостій").

cases.notes: "andé" is correctly treated as an error (DPD "andar", from memory).

cases.reviewerAnswer: None as written; with "Las llamo" the answer would be both (c)
cases.element: clips[0].transcript "—Busco a Marta y a Lucía. —La llamo ahora mismo."; translationUk "Зараз їй подзвоню."; option a keyed correct
cases.defect: The referent is two women, so the pronoun must be "las". "La" here is a grammar mismatch, and nothing makes it refer to Marta. Keying "Марті" rewards an unsupported reading, and the translation "їй" carries the same error. Also, "друга людина" in the prompt is awkward.
cases.correction: Change the clip to "—Las llamo ahora mismo." and key option c, or make the first line "Busco a Marta." Rephrase the prompt: "Кому зараз подзвонить співрозмовник?"
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática §16.2 (agreement of clitic with antecedent) (from memory)

cases.element: options[0] "Так, працює" outcome "correct"; options[1] "Ні, не працює" outcome "incorrect"
cases.defect: The clip says "Los domingos no abrimos", so the shop is closed on Sunday. The key is reversed.
cases.correction: Make option b correct and option a incorrect, with feedback: "«Los domingos no abrimos» — у неділю не працюють."

cases.element: prompt[1] es-ES paragraph "Hola, soy Elena. Llego al aeropuerto el viernes a las diez de la noche. ¿Puedes recogerme?"
cases.defect: A listening-meaning task shows the full transcript in the prompt. This leaks the answer and turns the item into a reading task (rule 7).
cases.correction: Remove the transcript from the prompt. If needed, provide it as a hint of kind "transcript".
cases.notes: Key and feedback are otherwise correct.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Mañana va a llover en Bilbao.
¿Me pasas el agua fría, por favor?

cases.notes: Terminology note on "тильда" as in cal-02.

cases.element: accepted v1 "mi"; errors e1 "mí" with feedbackUk "Тильда не потрібна: односкладові слова в іспанській пишуться без тильди."
cases.defect: After a preposition, the stressed pronoun is "mí", with a diacritic accent that distinguishes it from the possessive "mi". The key is reversed. The feedback rule is false: diacritic accents on monosyllables (mí, tú, él, té) are exactly the exception, and the course itself teaches tú/él/té.
cases.correction: Accept "mí". Add "mi" as an error with feedback: "Після прийменника — займенник «mí» з наголосом; «mi» без наголосу — це «мій»."
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), ch. II §3.4.3 (tilde diacrítica, mí/mi) (from memory)

cases.element: accepted v2 "habían" with noteUk "Теж правильно: дієслово узгоджується з «muchas personas»."
cases.defect: Existential haber is impersonal and stays in the singular. "Muchas personas" is its direct object, not its subject. "Habían muchas personas" is non-standard and should not be accepted or presented as correct.
cases.correction: Remove v2. Add "habían" as an error with feedback: "«haber» у значенні «бути, існувати» — безособове, тільки однина: «había muchas personas»."

cases.notes: Accepting "le" for a masculine singular person is in line with the RAE's tolerance of this leísmo (DPD "leísmo" 4a, from memory).
Both participles are valid in compound tenses (DPD "imprimir", from memory).

cases.element: errors e1 "freído" with feedbackUk "Форма «freído» неправильна: дієслово freír має лише дієприкметник «frito»."
cases.defect: freír has two valid participles. "freído" is correct in compound tenses (he freído), though "frito" is more common. The closed key rejects a valid answer, and the feedback gives a false rule.
cases.correction: Add "freído" to accepted with a noteUk: "Обидві форми правильні; «frito» вживається частіше." Remove e1 and add a real error, e.g., "freido" (missing accent).
